Brackets and dimension lines between two points

Source: R/layers-bracket.R
geom_bracket_3d.Rd

Marks the span from (x, y, z) to (xend, yend, zend) with a line set off to one side and an optional label at its middle. type = "bracket" draws a bracket whose tips point back at the two ends, as ggsignif::geom_signif() and ggpubr::geom_bracket() mark compared groups. type = "dimension" draws a dimension line as in technical drawing: extension lines from the two ends, and a line with arrowheads between them.

Usage

geom_bracket_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  type = c("bracket", "dimension"),
  offset = c(0, 0, 0.05),
  tip_length = 0.02,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments. ... takes fixed aesthetics and the 3D drawing parameters, and arrow replaces the arrowheads of dimension lines.

type

"bracket" or "dimension".

offset

Displacement of the line from the two ends, a vector c(x, y, z) in fractions of the panel box.

tip_length

Length of the bracket tips, and of the extension lines beyond the dimension line, in fractions of the panel box. Tips never reach past the two ends.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Details

The offset is in units of the panel box, so offset = c(0, 0, 0.05) lifts the line by 5% of the box height whatever the z scale. Without a zend mapping the span is level at z. The label is centred a little past the middle of the line, on the side of the offset: tip_length plus 3% of the box. Like other data, parts outside the panel box are clipped; dimension lines drawn outside an object at the edge of the box need coord_3d(clip_data = FALSE).

Aesthetics

x, y, xend and yend are required; z, zend, label, colour, linewidth, linetype, alpha and the text aesthetics size, family, fontface, lineheight, hjust, vjust and angle are optional.

Examples

cols <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = 1, z = c(4, 7, 5))
pair <- data.frame(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 1, yend = 1, z = 7.5, label = "p = 0.01")
ggplot2::ggplot(cols, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) +
  geom_col_3d() +
  geom_bracket_3d(ggplot2::aes(xend = xend, yend = yend, label = label), data = pair) +
  coord_3d()

box <- data.frame(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0, xend = 4, yend = 0, zend = 0, label = "4 m")
ggplot2::ggplot(box, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z, xend = xend, yend = yend,
                                zend = zend, label = label)) +
  geom_bracket_3d(type = "dimension", offset = c(0, -0.08, 0)) +
  coord_3d(clip_data = FALSE)
